data.name: Module.FirmwareUpdate.Description
data.value: Synchronizes NCF Host runtime and NcfDesktop application packages from GitHub into separate host/desktop folders and manifests.

data.name: Function.FirmwareUpdate.Settings.Description
data.value: Enable or disable automatic NCF Host and NcfDesktop package synchronization from GitHub and set a 1–24 hour check interval

data.name: Function.FirmwareUpdate.Sync.Description
data.value: Pull the latest NCF Host and NcfDesktop releases and update their local packages and manifests

data.name: Parameter.FirmwareUpdate.AutoMirror
data.value: Enable automatic mirroring||Sync NCF Host and NcfDesktop packages to ~/wwwroot/NcfPackages/host and desktop
